bias.en: Neutral turning bearish · lost the 30 and 100-day averages
bias.zh: 中性转弱 · 失守 30 日和 100 日均线

read.en: Amazon fell 1.9% on Oct 16 to $250.00. It is below the 5-day ($255.4), 10-day ($256.1), falling 30-day ($253.1) and falling 100-day ($252.3) averages, and above the rising 200-day ($242.7). MACD is still above its signal (since Oct 5) and above zero, but the histogram has faded to near zero and points to a cross. Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($263.4), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: 亚马逊 10月16日下跌 1.9%，收于 $250.00。股价位于 5 日（$255.4）、10 日（$256.1）、下行的 30 日（$253.1）和下行的 100 日均线（$252.3）下方，位于上行的 200 日均线（$242.7）上方。MACD 仍在信号线上方（自 10月5日起）及零轴之上，但柱状图已收窄至接近零，预示即将下穿。抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$263.4），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The close fell below the $252.3–253.1 zone (30 and 100-day averages) that held on Oct 15, which now caps, but the day's low held the $248.6 Oct 15 low. Resistance is $252–253, then $255.4–256.1 (5 and 10-day) and $263.7 (Oct 12 high). Support is $248.6, then $244.3–244.7 (Sep 16 and Sep 28 lows) and $242.7 (200-day). A close below $248.6 would open $244–245.

r.en: Oct 12 high, top of the Sep–Oct range; SAR
